attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates North Dakota state income tax per Form ND-1. North Dakota uses progressive tax brackets: 0% on first bracket, 1.95% on middle bracket, 2.5% on top bracket. Brackets vary by filing status. Starting with federal AGI, applies standard deduction based on filing status, then calculates tax using progressive brackets.

initial_action.action_dsl: add "NORTH DAKOTA FORM ND-1 - State Income Tax Calculation" to job.audit_trail; set result.nd_agi = result.agi; set result.nd_bracket_1_tax = 0; set result.nd_bracket_2_tax = 0; set result.nd_bracket_3_tax = 0
initial_action.action_postfix: "NORTH DAKOTA FORM ND-1 - State Income Tax Calculation" job.audit_trail swap addto result.agi /result.nd_agi xdef 0 /result.nd_bracket_1_tax xdef 0 /result.nd_bracket_2_tax xdef 0 /result.nd_bracket_3_tax xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate ND tax MFJ; Calculate ND tax with MFJ standard deduction and progressive brackets
action_details.action_dsl: add " Starting Federal AGI: $" + result.nd_agi + " (Form 1040 Line 11)" to job.audit_trail; set result.nd_standard_deduction = nd_standard_deduction_mfj; add " Standard Deduction (MFJ): $" + result.nd_standard_deduction to job.audit_trail; set result.nd_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.nd_agi - result.nd_standard_deduction) and 0; add " ND Taxable Income: $" + result.nd_taxable_income + " (AGI - Std Deduction)" to job.audit_trail; if result.nd_taxable_income > nd_bracket_3_threshold_mfj then { set result.nd_bracket_1_tax = nd_bracket_2_threshold_mfj * nd_bracket_1_rate; set result.nd_bracket_2_tax = (nd_bracket_3_threshold_mfj - nd_bracket_2_threshold_mfj) * nd_bracket_2_rate; set result.nd_bracket_3_tax = (result.nd_taxable_income - nd_bracket_3_threshold_mfj) * nd_bracket_3_rate; } else { if result.nd_taxable_income > nd_bracket_2_threshold_mfj then { set result.nd_bracket_1_tax = nd_bracket_2_threshold_mfj * nd_bracket_1_rate; set result.nd_bracket_2_tax = (result.nd_taxable_income - nd_bracket_2_threshold_mfj) * nd_bracket_2_rate; } else { set result.nd_bracket_1_tax = result.nd_taxable_income * nd_bracket_1_rate; } endif; } endif; set result.nd_tax = result.nd_bracket_1_tax + result.nd_bracket_2_tax + result.nd_bracket_3_tax; add " Total ND Tax: $" + result.nd_tax + " (Form ND-1)" to job.audit_trail
action_details.action_postfix: " Starting Federal AGI: $" result.nd_agi cvs strconcat " (Form 1040 Line 11)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto nd_standard_deduction_mfj /result.nd_standard_deduction xdef " Standard Deduction (MFJ): $" result.nd_standard_deduction cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.nd_agi result.nd_standard_deduction f- 0 fmax /result.nd_taxable_income xdef " ND Taxable Income: $" result.nd_taxable_income cvs strconcat " (AGI - Std Deduction)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.nd_taxable_income nd_bracket_3_threshold_mfj f> if nd_bracket_2_threshold_mfj nd_bracket_1_rate f* /result.nd_bracket_1_tax xdef nd_bracket_3_threshold_mfj nd_bracket_2_threshold_mfj f- nd_bracket_2_rate f* /result.nd_bracket_2_tax xdef result.nd_taxable_income nd_bracket_3_threshold_mfj f- nd_bracket_3_rate f* /result.nd_bracket_3_tax xdef " Bracket 1 (0% on $0-$80,975): $" result.nd_bracket_1_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Bracket 2 (1.95% on $80,975-$298,075): $" result.nd_bracket_2_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Bracket 3 (2.5% above $298,075): $" result.nd_bracket_3_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto else result.nd_taxable_income nd_bracket_2_threshold_mfj f> if nd_bracket_2_threshold_mfj nd_bracket_1_rate f* /result.nd_bracket_1_tax xdef result.nd_taxable_income nd_bracket_2_threshold_mfj f- nd_bracket_2_rate f* /result.nd_bracket_2_tax xdef " Bracket 1 (0% on $0-$80,975): $" result.nd_bracket_1_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Bracket 2 (1.95% on $80,975-$" result.nd_taxable_income cvs strconcat "): $" strconcat result.nd_bracket_2_tax cvs strconcat strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto else result.nd_taxable_income nd_bracket_1_rate f* /result.nd_bracket_1_tax xdef " Bracket 1 (0% on $0-$" result.nd_taxable_income cvs strconcat "): $" strconcat result.nd_bracket_1_tax cvs strconcat strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto endif endif result.nd_bracket_1_tax result.nd_bracket_2_tax f+ result.nd_bracket_3_tax f+ /result.nd_tax xdef " Total ND Tax: $" result.nd_tax cvs strconcat " (Form ND-1)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
